statement: The bank, its CRM, its relationship managers (RMs) and all internal process behaviour described here are hypothetical.
rationale: Portfolio design exercise; no internal data is available or used.

statement: All future CRM records will be synthetic and contain no real customer, employee, business, contact or banking information.
An acquisition prospect is an SME employer business with 1-499 employees operating in Canada.
rationale: Matches the analytical SME definition (1-499 employees).

statement: SGC 2021 CMA codes (analytics.dim_cma) are the common geographic key; locations outside the 41 CMAs map to a provincial remainder territory.
rationale: Reuses the validated reporting spine; avoids inventing a branch footprint.

statement: A synthetic forward-sortation-area (FSA) to CMA lookup will be generated for the synthetic data; no official postal-code conversion file is used in this design.
rationale: No postal crosswalk exists in the project; the lookup is a synthetic process assumption.

statement: Business hours are 08:30-17:00 local time, Monday to Friday, excluding a configurable statutory-holiday calendar per province.
rationale: Common business-banking convention used as a synthetic process assumption.

statement: All SLA durations are hypothetical, configurable values; production SLAs require approval by legal, compliance, operations and sales leadership.
rationale: No real service standards are known or claimed.

statement: RM capacity is expressed in configurable workload points; the base value of 40 points per full-time RM is a synthetic assumption.
rationale: Allows testable capacity rules without claiming a real limit.

statement: A later lead-priority model will output a band P1 (highest) to P3; until it exists every lead carries the default band P2.
rationale: SLA variation by priority needs a band; no score is built in this design.

statement: Market context comes from analytics.mart_cma_opportunity_framework using a configurable scenario (default: balanced); Tier 3 CMAs use analytics.mart_cma_scale_only_context.
rationale: External signal is context for prioritization, never an override of controls.

statement: Service language is used only when explicitly stated by the prospect; no language, identity or other personal characteristic is inferred.
Industry routing uses reviewed NAICS 2022 codes from analytics.dim_industry (system NAICS2022_1097, additive sectors); free-text industry is never used when a code exists.
Specialist industries and mandatory/preferred specialist matching are hypothetical configuration choices.
rationale: No real specialist coverage model is known.

statement: Duplicate matching uses synthetic identifiers and normalized synthetic attributes; no real business numbers are used.
Leads for businesses that already hold a synthetic banking relationship are excluded from acquisition routing and redirected to their existing owner.
rationale: Acquisition process covers new-to-bank prospects only.

statement: Synthetic-data rates (duplicate, invalid, reassignment, SLA breach, conversion) are design assumptions for test coverage, not banking benchmarks.
A closed-lost or withdrawn lead may be reopened only through an audited reopening event with manager approval within 180 days of closure.
rationale: Prevents silent reactivation of terminal leads.

statement: The synthetic operating period is 2025-06-01 to 2026-05-31, aligned with the trailing 12 months of the momentum evidence.
rationale: Keeps market context and CRM activity on a common period.
